info.name: Telnyx Access Tokens Charges Breakdown API

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start date for the charges breakdown in ISO date format (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: end_date
params.description: End date for the charges breakdown in ISO date format (YYYY-MM-DD). If not provided, defaults to start_date + 1 month. The date is exclusive, data for the end_date itself is not included in the report. The interval between start_date and end_date cannot exceed 31 days.

items.docs: Retrieve a detailed breakdown of monthly charges for phone numbers in a specified date range. The date range cannot exceed 31 days.
